name: Timeline
intent: Show a vertical sequence of phases — what is current, what is next, and what is later — without implying a chart or a table.
whenToUse: Onboarding or process steps where order matters more than dates
Status of a multi-stage workflow at a glance
whenNotToUse: Change over time with values — use LineChart

props.name: items
props.type: { id?: string, status: 'now' | 'next' | 'later', phase?: string, title: string, body?: string }[]
props.description: Ordered steps. status paints the rail: filled now, hollow next, muted later.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level for step titles so the page outline stays honest

a11y: label becomes aria-label on the list
Rail is aria-hidden; meaning lives in phase, title, and body
headingLevel keeps titles in the document outline

examples.title: Roadmap
examples.code: <Timeline label="Roadmap" items={[{ status: "now", phase: "Now", title: "V1 shipped", body: "React components with contracts, retrievable by agents." }, { status: "next", phase: "Next", title: "Retrieval accuracy" }]} />
